name: Astrid Christensen
bio:
Astrid Christensen's motorsport journey began unconventionally, not on the track, but in the workshops of her father's engineering firm in rural Denmark. She honed her technical skills early, immersed in the world of machinery and problem-solving. After earning a degree in mechanical engineering, she transitioned into motorsport, initially as a race engineer before moving into management roles.

At Walkenhorst Motorsport, Astrid is known for her meticulous approach to operations. She believes in a data-driven approach, constantly analyzing performance metrics to identify areas for improvement. Her demanding nature stems from a deep-seated desire to optimize every aspect of the team's performance. She pushes her team to innovate and find marginal gains, seeing it as crucial for maintaining a competitive edge. Astrid's blend of technical expertise and operational oversight makes her a unique and valuable asset to the team.

Astrid is known for her dedication to efficiency. She firmly believes that time is a precious resource and that every moment should be used productively. She’s been instrumental in implementing new technologies and processes to streamline the team's operations and improve overall efficiency. Her pragmatic approach and relentless pursuit of excellence have earned her the respect of her colleagues, even if they sometimes find her methods challenging.

physical.description: Astrid is a woman of medium height with a no-nonsense demeanor and a sharp gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations and ideas.
Insists on starting every team meeting exactly on time, regardless of who is present.
Has a collection of vintage motorsport posters in her office, each with a story behind it.
